scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,api -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:api"
scripts.setup:api: python3 -m venv api/.venv && api/.venv/bin/pip install -r api/requirements-dev.txt
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace web && api/.venv/bin/ruff check api
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace web && api/.venv/bin/pytest api
